claims.content: To capture, update, and manage the master details of every distributor including their unique code, name, address, contact information, and status to facilitate sales tracking and distribution.

goal.raw_text: To capture, update, and manage the master details of every distributor including their unique code, name, address, contact information, and status to facilitate sales tracking and distribution.

claims.content: VMU User
The VMU User must be logged into the system with appropriate permissions to access distributor records.
The system must have a master table structure in place for geographical location details (District, Sub-District, County, etc.) to populate address fields.
The system must ensure that no duplicate Distributor ID exists before allowing new record creation or updates.
If updating an existing distributor record, the system must verify that no child records (such as sales transactions) prevent deletion if a delete operation is intended.
The VMU User initiates the process to add, edit, or delete distributor records from the system interface.

trigger.raw_text: The VMU User initiates the process to add, edit, or delete distributor records from the system interface.

claims.content: The VMU User selects the option to create a new distributor record, edit an existing one, or delete a record from the system interface.
If creating a new record, the user enters mandatory fields including Distributor Code (3 Digit), Name of the distributor, Type of business, Proprietor Name, and Address details.
The system validates that all mandatory fields marked with '*' are filled; if any are missing, it prompts the user to complete them.
The system checks for duplicated ID for the distributors; if a duplicate ID is found, it prevents saving and notifies the user.
If a duplicate name is detected during entry, the system displays a warning message allowing the user to either keep the duplicate name or change it.

For address fields, the system provides drop-down selection menus populated from master tables for District, Sub-District, County, Sub-County, Village/Town, road or street to minimize data entry errors.
The user may optionally enter non-mandatory fields such as Designation, Contact No, Email Id, and Status (active/deactivate).
Upon successful validation, the system saves the distributor master details to the database.
If editing an existing record, the system allows updating available records but restricts deletion if child records (e.g., sales transactions) exist.
After saving, the system provides an option to print the distributor master details, subject to User Login Permission.

The user can view Sales History of a particular distributor by double-clicking on the grid in the distributor screen, which displays summary details including Batch No, Date of purchase, Qty Purchase, Qty Sold, Qty Returned, Balance Qty, and other MSIU office-required details.
If the system detects a duplicated Distributor ID during record creation or update, it prevents saving and notifies the user.
If a duplicate distributor name is entered, the system displays a warning message prompting the user to either retain the duplicate name or change it.
If any mandatory field (marked with '*') is left blank during data entry, the system prompts the user to complete all required fields before proceeding.
If the user attempts to delete a distributor record that has associated child records (e.g., sales transactions), the system blocks the deletion operation.
If the user lacks sufficient login permissions, the system denies access to print distributor master details or view sales history reports.
The distributor master details (including name, address, contact info, and status) are successfully saved or updated in the system database.
If a new record was created, the Distributor ID is unique and no duplicate IDs exist in the system.
If a duplicate distributor name was entered, the user has either accepted it with a warning or changed the name to avoid duplication.
Address fields reflect geographical location data captured from master tables (District, Sub-District, County, etc.) as per program requirements.

The system allows viewing of Sales History for the distributor via double-click on grid, displaying summary details such as Batch No, Date of purchase, Qty Purchase, Qty Sold, Qty Returned, Balance Qty, and other MSIU office-required details.
Print option for distributor master details is available only if the VMU User has appropriate login permissions.
No deletion occurred if child records (e.g., sales transactions) were associated with the distributor record.
